name: Formula Dynamics
old_description: Maintenance, repair, tuning, and upgrades for Ferrari, Maserati, Porsche, Lamborghini, McLaren, and the rest of the world's finest machines — backed by 20+ years of performance parts pedigree.
about:
Formula Dynamics operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, where it has run a performance parts business for over two decades before adding service bays. The company began as a specialist supplier of exhaust systems, tuning components, and genuine OEM parts for brands such as Ferrari, Maserati, and Lamborghini, eventually becoming the exclusive North American importer and distributor for Larini Systems exhausts. That parts pedigree led to the opening of a workshop that now handles maintenance, repair, tuning, and upgrades for the same exotic platforms.

The shop delivers factory-level service and performance work across nine makes — Ferrari, Maserati, Porsche, Lamborghini, McLaren, Aston Martin, Mercedes, Bentley, Rolls-Royce, and Audi. Capabilities include exhaust fitting and valve-controller setup, ECU and dyno tuning with baseline documentation, big-brake and carbon-ceramic servicing, forged-wheel sourcing with touchless mounting and road-force balancing, coilover installation with corner-weighting and alignment, dry-ice blasting for underbody and engine-bay restoration, paint correction, ceramic coating, and paint-protection film, plus turbo-system integration with supporting fueling and cooling hardware. A dyno cell, touchless tire equipment, and dry-ice blasting gear support the work, while the parts store continues to ship components worldwide.

Customers range from daily drivers to track-day participants and collectors who need documented service histories. The team services street and circuit cars alike, with recent work spanning Ferrari 488 brake upgrades, McLaren 720S ECU calibration, Lamborghini Huracán exhaust installations, and Rolls-Royce Phantom detailing. The parts division supplies owners and independent shops globally with platform-correct exhausts, suspension, and tuning hardware.

The company says its differentiator is a “baseline first, platform correct, prove the result” discipline: every car receives a health check before modifications, all fluids and torque specs follow manufacturer procedures, and dyno sheets plus road tests verify the outcome. Membership at Spring Mountain Motorsports Ranch provides track validation for parts and setups. Because parts sourcing, installation, and calibration share one roof, the shop avoids finger-pointing between supplier and installer, and it maintains documentation to collector standards for each vehicle’s history file.
